messages.subject: How To Flip the Y-Axis
parts:
I want to flip the tick marks to ascending order so that 1 is at the top and 5 is at the bottom. 

Here's the current graphic:

Here's the code:

ggplot(data = mahler, aes(x = Condition, y = Tan_Attitudes)) + geom_boxplot() + scale_x_discrete(name = "Condition") + scale_y_discrete(name = "Attitude Towards Tanning")


Does anyone have some suggestions for how to do this?

messages.author: f3f87164b9c7de94
messages.subject: Re: How To Flip the Y-Axis
parts:
After further Googling, I think I've figured it out, I just added scale_y_reverse() to the end:

ggplot(data = mahler, aes(x = Condition, y = Tan_Attitudes)) + geom_boxplot() + scale_x_discrete(name = "Condition") + scale_y_discrete(name = "Attitude Towards Tanning") + scale_y_reverse()

and it seems to have worked. source:
http://www.cookbook-r.com/Graphs/Axes_(ggplot2)/
